title: Ignore headings inside fenced code blocks and deduplicate slugs
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `md_toc/toc.py`:
1. Headings inside fenced code blocks (lines starting with ``` or ~~~, including language tags) must be ignored.
2. Duplicate heading slugs must be deduplicated GitHub-style: first is `foo`, second is `foo-1`, third is `foo-2`, etc.
3. Strip trailing `#` characters from ATX headings (e.g. `## Intro ##` -> `Intro`).
Run `pytest` to verify.
